title: Investigate QuadMixer for mesh integration
description: Look into https://github.com/stefanonuvoli/quadmixer — a tool for interactive mixing/blending of quad meshes (Nuvoli et al., SIGGRAPH Asia 2019). Evaluate whether its techniques (quad patch re-topology, boolean-like mixing operations, quad layout preservation) could inform or be integrated into Ixdar's mesh node system, especially for organic shape blending and HalfEdgeMesh operations.
definition-of-done: Short writeup captured in ticket or .cursor/docs/ai-learnings summarizing: (1) what QuadMixer does, (2) licensing, (3) whether it's applicable to Ixdar's pipeline, (4) recommended follow-up tickets if any.
testing-plan: N/A — research ticket. Deliverable is the writeup and any follow-up tickets filed.
